mutants.category: AMBA AHB-Lite & APB4 Interconnect / ALU XORI Decode
mutants.description: AMBA AHB-Lite / APB4 interconnect command filtering and peripheral address decoding bug: OP_XORI decodes to ALU_OR instead of ALU_XOR, corrupting in-register opcode equality checks (R3 ^ cmd == 0), causing valid commands to fail branch conditions and trap spuriously
